expectation: Nuclear signal in many nucleated cells, stronger in proliferating cells (crypt bases in gut epithelium, cycling lymphocytes); scattered positive stromal and endothelial nuclei. Absent from the cytoplasm and from off-tissue areas.
notes: Off-tissue background is as bright as the tissue and is dotted with debris blobs. The bright line in A runs along the tissue border. B and C show only haze that follows nuclear density. The bright spots in D are fuzzy and do not sit cleanly on nuclei.
observed: A: yellow haze over slide and tissue alike, off-tissue blobs, bright rim at the tissue edge. B/C: diffuse haze, whitish bands where nuclei are dense, no distinct positive nuclei. D: blurry yellow blobs between and partly over nuclei.
why: The signal follows the background, the tissue edge and nuclear density, not a distinct population of Rb-positive nuclei.
